욥기-10-1.title: 욥기 10장 1절 역사문법적 주해
욥기-10-1.exegesis: 35. it is not so with me-- As it now is, God not taking His rod away, I am not on such a footing of equality as to be able to vindicate myself.
욥기-10-1.theologicalNote: 35. it is not so with me-- As it now is, God not taking His rod away, I am not on such a footing of equality as to be able to vindicate myself.

욥기-10-2.title: 욥기 10장 2절 역사문법적 주해
욥기-10-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 10 Job 10:1-22 . Job's Reply to Bildad Continued. 1. leave my complaint upon myself-- rather, "I will give loose to my complaint" ( Job 7:11 ).
욥기-10-2.theologicalNote: CHAPTER 10 Job 10:1-22 . Job's Reply to Bildad Continued. 1. leave my complaint upon myself-- rather, "I will give loose to my complaint" ( Job 7:11 ).

욥기-10-3.title: 욥기 10장 3절 역사문법적 주해
욥기-10-3.exegesis: 2. show me, &c.-- Do not, by virtue of Thy mere sovereignty, treat me as guilty without showing me the reasons.
욥기-10-3.theologicalNote: 2. show me, &c.-- Do not, by virtue of Thy mere sovereignty, treat me as guilty without showing me the reasons.

욥기-10-4.title: 욥기 10장 4절 역사문법적 주해
욥기-10-4.exegesis: 3. Job is unwilling to think God can have pleasure in using His power to "oppress" the weak, and to treat man, the work of His own hands, as of no value ( Job 10:8 ; Psa 138:8 ). shine upon-- favor with prosperity ( Psa 50:2 ).
욥기-10-4.theologicalNote: 3. Job is unwilling to think God can have pleasure in using His power to "oppress" the weak, and to treat man, the work of His own hands, as of no value ( Job 10:8 ; Psa 138:8 ). shine upon-- favor with prosperity ( Psa 50:2 ).

욥기-10-5.title: 욥기 10장 5절 역사문법적 주해
욥기-10-5.exegesis: 4-6. Dost Thou see as feebly as man? that is, with the same uncharitable eye, as, for instance, Job's friends? Is Thy time as short? Impossible! Yet one might think, from the rapid succession of Thy strokes, that Thou hadst no time to spare in overwhelming me.
욥기-10-5.theologicalNote: 4-6. Dost Thou see as feebly as man? that is, with the same uncharitable eye, as, for instance, Job's friends? Is Thy time as short? Impossible! Yet one might think, from the rapid succession of Thy strokes, that Thou hadst no time to spare in overwhelming me.

욥기-10-8.title: 욥기 10장 8절 역사문법적 주해
욥기-10-8.exegesis: 7. "Although Thou (the Omniscient) knowest," &c. (connected with Job 10:6 ), "Thou searchest after my sin." and ... that none that can deliver out of thine hand-- Therefore Thou hast no need to deal with me with the rapid violence which man would use (see Job 10:6 ).
욥기-10-8.theologicalNote: 7. "Although Thou (the Omniscient) knowest," &c. (connected with Job 10:6 ), "Thou searchest after my sin." and ... that none that can deliver out of thine hand-- Therefore Thou hast no need to deal with me with the rapid violence which man would use (see Job 10:6 ).

욥기-10-9.title: 욥기 10장 9절 역사문법적 주해
욥기-10-9.exegesis: 8. Made-- with pains; implying a work of difficulty and art; applying to God language applicable only to man. together round about-- implying that the human body is a complete unity, the parts of which on all sides will bear the closest scrutiny.
욥기-10-9.theologicalNote: 8. Made-- with pains; implying a work of difficulty and art; applying to God language applicable only to man. together round about-- implying that the human body is a complete unity, the parts of which on all sides will bear the closest scrutiny.

욥기-10-10.title: 욥기 10장 10절 역사문법적 주해
욥기-10-10.exegesis: 9. clay-- Job 10:10 proves that the reference here is, not so much to the perishable nature of the materials, as to their wonderful fashioning by the divine potter.
욥기-10-10.theologicalNote: 9. clay-- Job 10:10 proves that the reference here is, not so much to the perishable nature of the materials, as to their wonderful fashioning by the divine potter.

욥기-10-11.title: 욥기 10장 11절 역사문법적 주해
욥기-10-11.exegesis: 10. In the organization of the body from its rude commencements, the original liquid gradually assumes a more solid consistency, like milk curdling into cheese ( Psa 139:15 , 16 ). Science reveals that the chyle circulated by the lacteal vessels is the supply to every organ.
욥기-10-11.theologicalNote: 10. In the organization of the body from its rude commencements, the original liquid gradually assumes a more solid consistency, like milk curdling into cheese ( Psa 139:15 , 16 ). Science reveals that the chyle circulated by the lacteal vessels is the supply to every organ.

욥기-10-12.title: 욥기 10장 12절 역사문법적 주해
욥기-10-12.exegesis: 11. fenced-- or "inlaid" ( Psa 139:15 ); "curiously wrought" [Umbreit]. In the foetus the skin appears first, then the flesh, then the harder parts.
욥기-10-12.theologicalNote: 11. fenced-- or "inlaid" ( Psa 139:15 ); "curiously wrought" [Umbreit]. In the foetus the skin appears first, then the flesh, then the harder parts.

욥기-10-13.title: 욥기 10장 13절 역사문법적 주해
욥기-10-13.exegesis: 12. visitation-- Thy watchful Providence. spirit-- breath.
욥기-10-13.theologicalNote: 12. visitation-- Thy watchful Providence. spirit-- breath.

욥기-10-14.title: 욥기 10장 14절 역사문법적 주해
욥기-10-14.exegesis: 13. is with thee-- was Thy purpose. All God's dealings with Job in his creation, preservation, and present afflictions were part of His secret counsel ( Psa 139:16 ; Ac 15:18 ; Ec 3:11 ).
욥기-10-14.theologicalNote: 13. is with thee-- was Thy purpose. All God's dealings with Job in his creation, preservation, and present afflictions were part of His secret counsel ( Psa 139:16 ; Ac 15:18 ; Ec 3:11 ).

욥기-10-15.title: 욥기 10장 15절 역사문법적 주해
욥기-10-15.exegesis: 14-15. Job is perplexed because God "marks" every sin of his with such ceaseless rigor. Whether "wicked" (godless and a hypocrite) or "righteous" (comparatively sincere), God condemns and punishes alike.
욥기-10-15.theologicalNote: 14-15. Job is perplexed because God "marks" every sin of his with such ceaseless rigor. Whether "wicked" (godless and a hypocrite) or "righteous" (comparatively sincere), God condemns and punishes alike.

욥기-10-17.title: 욥기 10장 17절 역사문법적 주해
욥기-10-17.exegesis: 16. increaseth-- rather, "(if) I lift up (my head) Thou wouldest hunt me," &c. [Umbreit]. and again-- as if a lion should not kill his prey at once, but come back and torture it again.
욥기-10-17.theologicalNote: 16. increaseth-- rather, "(if) I lift up (my head) Thou wouldest hunt me," &c. [Umbreit]. and again-- as if a lion should not kill his prey at once, but come back and torture it again.

욥기-10-18.title: 욥기 10장 18절 역사문법적 주해
욥기-10-18.exegesis: 17. witnesses-- His accumulated trials were like a succession of witnesses brought up in proof of his guilt, to wear out the accused. changes and war-- rather, "(thou settest in array) against me host after host" (literally, "changes and a host," that is, a succession of hosts); namely, his afflictions, and then reproach upon reproach from his friends.

욥기-10-21.title: 욥기 10장 21절 역사문법적 주해
욥기-10-21.exegesis: 20. But, since I was destined from my birth to these ills, at least give me a little breathing time during the few days left me ( Job 9:34 ; 13:21 ; Psa 39:13 ).
욥기-10-21.theologicalNote: 20. But, since I was destined from my birth to these ills, at least give me a little breathing time during the few days left me ( Job 9:34 ; 13:21 ; Psa 39:13 ).
